## Overview

An **exhibition item** records that one artwork was shown in one exhibition, together with the details that only the exhibition catalogue knows: catalogue number, catalogue page and the title as printed. It is the association between the [Artwork](artwork-datamodel.qmd) model and the exhibition model.

The model is defined in [wikibase-model.json](wikibase-model.json). The tables below are generated from it.

::: {.callout-note}
The field list is **provisional** (version 0.1).
:::

## ER Diagram

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    EXHIBITION ||--o{ EXHIBITION_ITEM : "includes"
    ARTWORK ||--o{ EXHIBITION_ITEM : "is shown as"
    PLACE |o--o{ EXHIBITION : "held at"
    PERSON ||--o{ ARTWORK : "creates"

    EXHIBITION {
        string exhibition_id PK
        string title
        date start_date
        date end_date
        string venue_id FK
        string wikidata_qid
    }
    EXHIBITION_ITEM {
        string item_id PK
        string artwork_id FK
        string exhibition_id FK
        string catalogue_number
        string catalogue_page
        string title_as_exhibited
        string notes
    }
    ARTWORK {
        string artwork_id PK
        string title
        string creator_id FK
    }
    PERSON {
        string person_id PK
        string name
    }
    PLACE {
        string term_id PK
        string label_en
    }
```

`ARTWORK` is shown with key fields only; see [Artwork Data Model](artwork-datamodel.qmd) for the full entity.

## Why a separate exhibition item?

A statement "artwork X was in exhibition Y" cannot hold catalogue number, page or the title as printed without qualifiers. An item of its own keeps these values together, works for artworks that appear in several exhibitions, and maps directly to CIDOC CRM (an activity that used a specific object).

## Classes

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

model = json.loads(Path("wikibase-model.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ns = model["namespaces"]

def cell(v):
    return "" if v in (None, "") else str(v).replace("|", "\\|")

print("| Class | Label (EN / DE) | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for c in model["classes"]:
    if c["key"] not in {"exhibition", "exhibition_item"}:
        continue
    e = c["equivalents"]
    wd = e.get("wikidata")
    wd_cell = f"[{wd}]({ns['wikidata']}{wd})" if wd else ""
    print(f"| **{c['key']}** | {c['label_en']} / {c['label_de']} | {wd_cell} | {cell(e.get('cidoc'))} | {cell(e.get('linked_art'))} | {cell(e.get('lido'))} |")
```

## Properties

```{python}
#| output: asis
USES = {"exhibition", "exhibition_item"}

print("| Property | Label (EN / DE) | Wikibase datatype | Used on | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for p in model["properties"]:
    if not (set(p["used_on"]) & USES) or p["key"] in {"local_id", "instance_of", "wikidata_qid"}:
        continue
    e = p["equivalents"]
    print("| " + " | ".join([
        f"**{p['key']}**",
        f"{p['label_en']} / {p['label_de']}",
        p["datatype"],
        ", ".join(u for u in p["used_on"] if u in USES),
        cell(e.get("wikidata")),
        cell(e.get("cidoc")),
        cell(e.get("linked_art")),
        cell(e.get("lido")),
    ]) + " |")
```

`local_id`, `instance_of` and `wikidata_qid` apply to every class and are listed on the [Artwork Data Model](artwork-datamodel.qmd) page.

## Example

Baldessari catalogue (Sprengel Museum Hannover), item `ITM002`:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `item_id` | ITM002 |
| `artwork_id` | ART002 (THESE TOO, 1997, print) |
| `exhibition_id` | EXH001 (John Baldessari, Sprengel Museum Hannover) |
| `catalogue_page` | 14; 51 |

## Corrections to the earlier draft

| Earlier mapping | Problem | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Exhibited at: P1431 | P1431 is "executive producer" | P608 "exhibition history" |
| Depth: P2610 | P2610 is "thickness" | P5524 "depth" |
| Acquisition: P1830, provenance: P2670 | Both properties have other meanings | Removed from this model |
| Instance of: Q3305213 | Q3305213 is "painting" | Q838948 "work of art" plus an object type item |
| CIDOC location: P87 | P87 is "is identified by" for places | P55 "has current location" |
| Series: P108 | P108 is "has produced" | Removed from this model |
| Wikibase4Research column | Dropped from scope | Linked Art and LIDO columns |

## CSV template

[templates/exhibition-item.csv](templates/exhibition-item.csv) holds the exhibition items, and [templates/exhibition.csv](templates/exhibition.csv) the exhibitions. Both use `local ID` values for repeatable loads.

| File | Columns |
|---|---|
| `exhibition.csv` | `exhibition_id, title, start_date, end_date, venue_id, wikidata_qid` |
| `exhibition-item.csv` | `item_id, artwork_id, exhibition_id, catalogue_number, catalogue_page, title_as_exhibited, notes` |
